title: Числа 19 — Numbers 19
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: …to bring you a red heifer without defect.
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) takes the genitive → изъяна.

cases.translation: Give her to Eleazar the priest.
cases.explain: The dative marks the recipient of отдайте ("give to the priest") → священнику.

cases.sentence: Потом пусть её выведут за ___ и заколят.
cases.translation: Then let her be led outside the camp and slaughtered.
cases.explain: With motion ("beyond"), the preposition за takes the accusative; for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → лагерь.
Нечистота is the subject of остаётся (remains) — the doer takes the nominative → нечистота.

cases.translation: …and lay it in a clean place outside the camp.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "in / on" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → месте.

cases.sentence: Теперь он сможет войти в лагерь, но будет нечист до ___.
cases.translation: Now he may enter the camp, but will be unclean until evening.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until) takes the genitive → вечера.

cases.sentence: Любой, кто прикоснётся к мёртвому человеческому ___, будет нечист семь дней.
cases.translation: Anyone who touches a dead human body will be unclean for seven days.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / against) after прикоснуться takes the dative → телу.

cases.sentence: Пусть он очистит себя ___ на третий и на седьмой день.
cases.translation: Let him purify himself with water on the third and the seventh day.
cases.explain: The instrumental expresses the means by which he cleanses himself ("with water") → водой.

reading.ru: Любой, кто прикоснется к мертвому человеческому телу, будет нечист семь дней.
reading.question: How long is someone unclean after touching a dead body?
reading.explain: Whoever touches a dead human body is unclean for seven days.

reading.ru: Пусть он очистит себя водой на третий и на седьмой день, потом он будет чист.
reading.question: On which days must the unclean person purify himself?
options: The third and the seventh day
The first and the last day
The second and the sixth day
reading.correct: The third and the seventh day
reading.explain: He is to cleanse himself with water on the third and seventh days, and then he will be clean.

reading.ru: Пусть тот, кто чист, соберет пепел Телицы и положит его на чистом месте вне лагеря.
reading.question: Who is to gather the ashes of the heifer?
reading.explain: A person who is clean gathers the ashes and lays them in a clean place outside the camp.

reading.ru: Пусть священник Илиазар возьмет на палец кровь Телицы и покропит ею семь раз переднюю сторону шатра собрания.
reading.question: How many times does the priest sprinkle the blood toward the tent?
reading.explain: The priest sprinkles the heifer's blood toward the front of the tent seven times.

reading.ru: Любой сосуд без крышки будет нечист, любой прикоснувшийся в поле к убитому мечом или к умершему своей смертью, и любой прикоснувшийся к человеческой кости или могиле будет нечист семь дней.
reading.question: Which kind of vessel is declared unclean?
reading.explain: The text says any open vessel without a covering is unclean.

reading.ru: Любой, кто прикоснется к воде очищения, будет нечист до вечера.
reading.question: What happens to one who touches the water of cleansing?
reading.explain: Whoever touches the water for cleansing is unclean until evening.
